tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don dang phyag len gsal bar bkod pa las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba dngos grub myur stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥgu ru shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍa le bhyaḥ 'brel tshad don ldan sngags 'chang chen po dang / /dbyer med 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la/ /yan lag mchog gi gus pas rab btud nas/ /de yis bsnyen pa las rung gang zag gis/ /de nyid mchod cing sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang / /dam tshig nyams chags lhag chad rab bskangs nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg cho ga legs par bshad par bya/ /de la 'dir/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing / /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni/ /sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur pa thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan zhing / bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bsgrub pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ dben bzhin yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang phyag dar dang rkyang nus byas te bla phreng sogs kyis brgyan zhing / bris sku sogs rten yod na bshams pa'i mdun du mchod stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma lag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / sgrub pa po kha shar du bltas pa'i mdun du thab kyi stegs gru bzhi rgya ma chung tsam sa dkar gyi byugs shing nyung dang dri bzang kyang byugs par bya'o/ /de'i dbus su sa lha'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ byang shar du sa lha'i gtor ma gcig rang nyid kha shar du phyogs pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/

nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru sogs bshams/ de nas stan la 'dug ste/ thab kyi khang pa gsar pa'am spro na gnas yo byin rlabs dkyil chog bzhin byas la/ skyabs gsum gsal 'debs nas/ bsgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur/ gyi bar byas la/ de nas rang gi srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar haṃ yig 'bar ba/ haṃ haṃ haṃ zhes brjod pas sa g.yos pas rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol zhes smra bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa las dmigs te/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur zhes pa'i bar/ oṃ ārghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis byin brlabs/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi gṛhṇa daṃ/ arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi/ sogs mgo mjug 'dra ba la pā dyaṃ gyi zhabs bsil dbul/ de nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūm̐ zhes dang / gaṇḍe ra ṇi/ rol chen dang bcas byed/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gi sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pri thi bi de wi na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga te i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/

/spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab ba'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi sbyin sreg byed par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod sbyin sreg gi las ci bder gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin par bsam/ oṃ pri thi bi/ sogs gong bzhin gyi chu gnyis phul la/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg ste/ badzra muḥsa'i lha mo de nyid du thim par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas las dang bya bas skyon sbyangs pa ni/ mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdus/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pas thab kyi sa la dri bzang gi chu gtor la/ sumbha ni sogs brjod pas sa phyogs bgegs dang bral bar bsam/ de nas lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas ku sha thab kyi gzhi la dri bzang gtor zhing / oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pa nyer gcig brjod pas sa'i skyon sbyangs shing / sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ yang sngar bzhin dri bzang gtor la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes nyer gcig brjod pas sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /de nas thab kyi sa gzhi la rdo rje'i rtse nang mchod gtor la/ sumbha nis bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gi mtshan pa hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu mda'i drwa ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me di ni/ sogs phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum re sgrub thabs bzhin brjod la sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs so/ /las dang bya ba'i skyon sbyangs pa'i sumbha ni sogs sngags gsum dang / ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i sa chog bsdus pa 'di ni/ cho ga tshang ba'i phyir sngar sa chog byas pa'i sar yang phyag len la nges par mdzad do/ /de nas bde mchog gi gtor ma byin gyis rlabs nas/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa'i thun gtor 'bul ba yan byas la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang la/ ma 'byor ba sogs kyi nongs par bzod par gsol la rten yod pa la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol byas la/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdud/ de nas rang la yab yum gyi go cha gnyis dang / go cha chen po bsgo/ sumbha ni phyag rgya dang bcas pa tshar gnyis kyi tshams rngam sngags kyi bsrung bar bya/ de nas dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i sogs nas/ bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhes pa'i bar brjod la bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa bya/ 'di rnams sbyin sreg dngos gzhi'i nyi ma gong ma'i gza' skar bzang ba la snga bar bya'o/ /de nas thab kyi gzhi sa stegs gru bzhi/ de'i steng du thig chen brgyad spyi dang maṇḍal sar btab la zhi ba'i thab khung khru gang gi tshad bskor ba'i skor cig gi nang du 'khor lo rim pa gsum/ lte ba sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad de bde chen 'khor lo rnams mtshan la phyag mtshan 'bris pa/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rwa ba ka ba/ dam tshig 'khor lo'i mtshan ma sku 'khor gyi phyi'i bzlum thig gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du gri gug bkod tshul legs phyi'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin tsag gi bri'o/ /de'i phyi rol du cha chen re re yod pa'i zlum thig zlum po gnyis bskor ba kha khyer dang mu ran yin pas rdo rje'i phreng ba kha thum pas bskor ba bris/

de'i mthar gru bzhi'i thig gdab la kha phyag sor bzhir byas pa'i nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes kha thum pa mtshan pa bris/ lha'i gnas rnams su 'bras sam nas kyi tshom bu bkod/ kha khyer gyi shar lhor me lha'i tshom bu gcig dang / spos sbyor ba'i rtse mo gcig bzhag de'i mthar phyag len bzhin bud shing brtan par gcig go /de'i mthar bskor thab kyi khru do tsam gyi ring bar mda' sgro bkod tshul ni me yol gyi mdun bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo'i dod du mda' gnyis g.yas g.yon du btsugs/ gzhan phyogs mtshams mdun du mda' re ste dgu'o/ /mda' de dag la tshon skud sna lnga phyag len bzhin dkri tshul ni me yol gyi mdun gyis mda' g.yon gyi rtse la dkris/ de nas g.yon bskor gyi g.yas kyi mda'i rtsa ba la dkris/ byang shar gyi rtse la/ byang gis rtsa ba la/ nub byang gi rtse la/ nub gyi rtsa ba la/ lho nub kyi rtse/ lho'i rtsa ba la/ shar lho'i rtse la/ de nas thog ma'i mda'i rtsa ba la/ de'i g.yas kyi rtse la/ byang shar gyi rtsa ba/ byang gi rtse/ nub byang gi rtsa ba/ nub kyi rtse/ lho nub kyi rtsa ba/ lho'i rtse/ shar lho'i rtsa ba/ de nas thog ma'i rtse la dkris pas chos 'byung gi dbyibs su 'byung ngo / /phyogs gsum gyi mda' dang / rang gi mdun gyi g.yas phyogs kyi mda' la me long re btags/ snod gang yang rung ba nas kyi bkang la lcags bsam seng ldeng gi phur pa bcu la yungs dkar gyi thum bu nang / dar dmar gyi cod paṇa btags pa btsugs la bzhag thong ni rang gi phyag rgya byas pa la tshangs rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma mnyam pa'i ku sha'i chun por brgyad kyang sta gon bya/ sgrub pa po'i mdun dang / me yol gyi bar du btegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ g.yas su rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru g.yon du dril bu nang mchod/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar te bzhag go /mdun gyi g.yas su dri lnga bcas pa'i dri lnga ni/

tsandan dkar dmar gur kum ga bur dzā ti dang lnga'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i chus gang ba'i dung chos ku sha'i 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ 'di ni bsang chu dang mchod yon dang po yin no/ /g.yon phyogs su 'o ma dang 'bras yos dang / ku sha'i myu gu dang / dri bzang rnams rab sa'i chus bkang ba'i dung chos gcig bzhag go /'di ni mchod yon gnyis pa yin/ sgrub pa po'i g.yon phyogs thab kyis brtags gru bzhi'i rtsa ba na mar mchod gzhi ras dkar bting ba'i khar zhabs bsil nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga bshams pa 'jig rten pa'i yin/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga spyi mchod du bsham mo/ /'jig rten pa'i mchod pa'i rgyab bam/ 'og tu gtor ma gcig bshams pa me lha 'khor bcas kyi'o/ /yang rang gi g.yas phyogs su thab kyi stegs gru bzhi'i rtsa ba na mar mchod gzhi ras dkar bting ba'i khar/ yam shing mar til sha lnga dang / zas mchog ku sha dur ba nas/ gro dang so ba/ 'bras sran ma dza ti la sogs legs par bshams/ zhes pa ltar shing 'o ma can bcas pa lcang dkar la sogs pa gas grum med pa sbom phra mtheb chen nas mthe'u chung gi bar dang / ring thung sor brgyad pa'am/ khru gang pa'am sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtse mo mar dang sbrang rtsi dang dri bzang po'i byugs pa'i yam shing dang / 'bru mar zhu bas til dang / las kyi shi ba'i ba glang gi sha dum bur btub cing bsngos pa la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang / zho mar phye gsum dang sbrang bu ram rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog ku sha dang / dur ba dang / nas dang / gro dang / so ba dang / 'bras dang / sran ma dang / dzā ti la sogs pa'i 'bru sna tshogs bzhag go /til nag 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar zangs sder sogs snod bzang por bkod nas bzhag go /ku sha dang yam shing la snod med par mchod gzhi'i steng bkod pa'o// ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/

bdag nyid lhar bskyed cing stang stabs sogs bya ba/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyad par gyi tshe bsgrub pa po kha shar phyogs su blta/ gzhan yang grogs dang bcas pa stan dkar po dang / gos dkar po gyon/ rgyan shel gyi phreng ba sogs dkar po'i rgyan la stan bde ba la 'dug ste spro na gnas yo byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar dang / lhag chad kyi yig brgya tshar gsum brjod la rdzogs rim gyi gong bzhin bsdus te/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas sumbha ni phyag rgya dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas langs te/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las steng dang 'og tu kha ṣa ro hā/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sa phyogs kyi bgegs thams cad bskrad cing bral bar gyur/ rang gi rkang mthil sna tshogs rdo rje re re/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas gar gyi 'gying brtsam pa ni/ rkang pa g.yas la g.yon gyi mdun bskor te sngar shugs su bzhag pa dang gar bskor gyi rjes su g.yas rdo rje thugs kar dang / g.yon dril bu kur bzhag pa'am khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan nas rked par 'jog pa gang rung bya'o/ /de lta bu lan gsum byas na rdo rje'i 'gros ni bzhi 'gros gsum dang / khro bo 'gros dang bzhir gsungs la/ bzhi 'gros gsum gyi dang po'i rgya mtsho bskyed pa ni lag pa gar bskor dang / rkang mthil gnyis res mos kyi mdun nas bskor te g.yab skyin 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa ri bo 'degs pa ni/ gom pa g.yon pa mdun du g.yab skyin spo ba'i tshe lag pa gar bskor gyis rjes su g.yas phyogs su/ ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul bya zhing / g.yas pa spo ba'i tshe g.yon phyogs su bya ba re mos du bya'o/

/gsum pa mdzes ma'i gom pa ni/ mdun du spo ba ngos mdun nas g.yab cing mi spo ba ngos kyi brla la btsugs nas khyim bya'i gom pa ltar 'gro ba'o/ /lag pa gar bskor/ bzhi pa khro bo'i gom pa ni/ rkang pa g.yon mdun du brdab pa'i tshe lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas rgyang nas g.yon dril bu snying kar bsil/ rkang g.yas mdun du brdab pa'i tshe/ lag g.yas rdo rje snying kar bzung / g.yon dril bu brkyang te bsil ba res mos kyi 'gro ba'o/ /de ltar bskor ba bzhi la re re'am yang na bskor ba bzhi ka la zhi ba gsum gyis rgya mtsho bskyod pa sbyangs pa byas kyang yong ngo / /de lta bu'i g.yon bskor du 'gro zhing / shar du g.yas brkyang dang / lhor g.yon brkyang / nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po'i stang stabs rnams bya zhing / stang stabs byas la lag g.yas brkyang ni/ g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang gnyis bar la mtho lnga brkyangs pa'i g.yas brkyang dang / lag gnyis rgyab sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel shing bzhis 'gros pa'o/ /g.yon brkyang ni/ g.yon sngon 'gro'i rkang gnyis bar la mtho lnga pa rgyangs pa'i g.yon brkyang dang / phyag rgya sngar gyi la mdzub mo bsgreng ba dang bzhin khros pa'o/ /sa ga ni g.yon sngon 'gro'i rkang gnyis bgrad pa'i bar la khru gang dang sor gnyis su byas te pus mo drang por bsrangs te lag g.yas rdo rje'i snying ga dang / g.yon dril bu dkur bzung zhing bzhin zhi ba'o/ /zlum po ni g.yas sngon 'gro'i rkang pa cung bgrad pa'i pus mo gnyis rgyangs pa'i bar la khru dor byas te ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu dang / lag pa gnyis phyogs mtshams thams cad du gar byed cing bzhin skrag pa'i tshul lo/ /kha nang du lta ba'i tshe sa gzhi byin rlabs cing / phyir lta ba'i tshe bgegs rnams bskrad pa bsam mo/ /de ltar phyogs re'i stang stabs la bskor ba re re byas pa'i bskor ba bzhi dang /

stang stabs tshul brgyad du 'gyur la/ thams cad du hūm̐ drag tu brjod cing rkang pa'i rjes sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam la de nas stan la 'dug ste/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i nam mkhar/ na da/ thig le/ zla tshes/ mgo bo/ khog pa/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na larka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs pa bsgom pa yang sumbha ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa tshar gnyis brjod la/ sngar spros pa'i khaṇḍa ro ha gnyis sogs pho nya rnams las nying sprul dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bdag la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad rdo rje rwa ba'i phyi rol du bkug nas lcags sgrog bzhag pas bsdams te mi g.yo bar gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas gong gi phur bu bcu po mdun du bzhag ngag tu/ hūm̐ las phur bu rnams stod khro bo'i rnam pa can la/ smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi phur bu badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ro gcig par gyur pa pho nya rnams kyi phyag g.yon par gtad cing / g.yas par rdo rje tho ba gtad pas phur bu'i mgo bo nas brdungs te/ bgegs rnams spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar phug par gyur/ oṃ kā kā sya/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya nas/ la ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyi bar brjod cing / phur bu rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas rim pa bzhin blangs la gtad/ rang gi lag pa'i phyag rgya sgrub thabs bzhin dang / phur bu rnams las kyi slob mas rim pa bzhin shar gyi g.yon phyogs nas brtsam te btab/ de bzhin du byang gi phur bu gdab pas bstun/ oṃ lū lū kā sya sogs brjod cing gdab ste rang rang gi sngags sngon du 'gro bas/

thā nā sye sogs kyi nub kyi g.yas dang / pū ka rā sye sogs kyis lho dang / a ma dhī ye sogs kyi shar lho/ oṃ ya ma du tī ye sogs kyi lho nub/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇi ye sogs gyi nub byang / oṃ ya ma rma tha nā ye sogs kyi byang shar/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro ha sogs kyis steng gi phur pa shar gyi g.yas dang / yang sngags khaṇḍa ro ha sogs kyi 'og gi phur pa nub kyi g.yon du gdab bo/ /rje btsun gyi nag po'i dkyil chog las phur bu bcu ni rang gi snying gar nas ting 'dzin gyi sprul pa'i phur bu rnams gnod mdzes su bsam la de rnams sngon gyi sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang khaṇḍa ro ha gnyis kyi lag pa g.yon par gtad/ oṃ gha gha sogs brjod cing bgegs rnams spyi bor btsugs pa bsam mo zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de lta bu bsam mo/ /sems kyi bgegs rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas zhing lus thal ba'i phung por gyur pa dang / phur pa rnams khro bo'i rnam pas gnas de dag tu bzhugs par bsam mo/ /phur pa gdab tshar ba dang / pho nya rnams rdo rje rwa ba'i kha khyer la zhal phyir gzigs te 'khod nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ji srid ma tshar gyi bar du bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ ces brjod cing phur pa rnams la thun mong du/ oṃ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing tsandan dmar po'i dri'i thig le'i tshab ku sha'i dri bzang gtor/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing las kyi rdo rjes gu gul gyi bdug pas mchod/ de nas/ oṃ badzra rakṣaḥrakṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bsrung bas 'khor lo brtan par byas par bsam mo/ /bum bskyed las grub kyi nyes pa med gsungs pas cho ga zor yangs pa'i phyir bzhag de nas sa chu dang mchod yon gnyis la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/

sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon gnyis dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad thams cad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i ye shes kyi chu dang / me lha dga' bar byed cing zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i bdud rtsi chu rgyun du gyur/ mchod yon dang po la/ sumbha ni nyi shu rtsa bdun dang mchod yon gnyis pa la yi ge bdun ma brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bsangs chu nas ku sha 'thor g.yab kyi thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor nas/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ oṃ dzrīṃ swāhā/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod cing byin gyis rlabs/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsegs pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po'i steng du raṃ las bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba ra skyes la zhon pa/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyu gu rtse gsum pa dang skyabs sbyin g.yon gnyis na bgrang 'phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug dang / sma ra'i ag tshom can lus thams cad las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun 'babs pa/ zhi ba'i las bsgrub par mdzad pa/ drang srong gi tshogs thams cad bskor ba/ de'i snying gar paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i mdun zur nas g.yon bskor gyis 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med kyis khams dag pa/ oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ ā las padma dmar po ās mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / dbus su baṃ las de dag thams cad 'dres pa las byung ba'i khams gsum gyis bdag po dpal he ru ka nyid gong du bskyed pa ma dag pa'i me lha'i rnam pa can chu'i dkyil la bzhugs par gyur/ 'dab ma brgyad dang steng 'og gnyis su skad cig gi oṃ ant+ra ye/ agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ ba ya ba ye/ ku be ra ye/ i shwa ra ye/ urdhaṃ bra ha ma/ a ti tra te bhya te/ phyogs skyong ba chen po bcu rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa mngon sum bzhin du 'khod par gyur/ phyi nang gi lha de dag thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya sna drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/

/oṃ agne ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba kā ma pra pā dhā ka ma hā bhu ta de ba ṛ ti dwi dza patta ma gṛ hi tā/ kā ru ṇi ka sarba sattasd+ya kṛ tā ā hūm̐ ā hā ra/ a smin panni hi ho bha wa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra sa pa ka agne ye ma ma shīntaṃ ku ri ye swāhā/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ agne ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ gis bar gyi mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a na la mā hā bhu ra dza lā ya/ sarba duṣṭan bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tra shya ho dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma a sti/ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang lha de dag gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lha rnams kyi snying kar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi sogs nas/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa/ haṃ ljang gu rta mchog dang / zhes pa'i bar brjod pas yab kyi go cha bcing byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyi mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ shrī tsakra bī ra staṃ/ oṃ kā kā sya sogs nas/ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing phyi nang gi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang gi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro mas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra phaṭa laṃ pa a bhi ṣiñtsa badzra ru ṣye he zhes pa dang dbyangs dang / oṃ ratna ma la a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ zhes brjod pa la rin po che 'phreng bas dbu rgyan pa bsam mo/ /de nas ku sha'i chun pa'i brgyad la bsangs chu gtor nas/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang / rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bag pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /hūm̐ las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa'i sa ni dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las zhi zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥm mi shīntaṃ kurbantu swāhā/ zhes brjod cing ku sha'i rtse mo phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas mda' stan dang tshon skud me long rnams sngar bkram zin pas de dag gnas khang brgyan zhing bsrung ba'i phyir/ sumbha ni tshar gcig brjod pas/ mda' stan tshon skud me long sogs byin gyis rlabs cing bkram par bsam mo/ /de na sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong me sbor bar bshad kyang phyag len la skabs 'dir mdzad pa spor sde sbar nas thab la g.yon phyogs nas lan gsum bskor zhing / 'di'i skabs kyis skor ba thams cad g.yon bskor kho na'o/ /oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas thab nang gi ting lo sbar zhing / me ni rdo nang lcags rtsub pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ 'o ma can rtsub pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /phus mi btab rlung g.yab kyi sbyar ro/ /de nas yam shing / gzhan dang bcas pas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing mar blug gzar gsum nang dzwa la'i sngags kyi me gso/ de nas me lha nang de'i thugs ka'i lha thams cad kyi ljags dang / dgang blugs kyi nang du oṃ yi ge mtshan par bsam la/ oṃ agha ne swāhā/ oṃ ḍa ki ni dzi na dzika swāhā/ oṃ agha ne ye di bya di bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya/ ka bya/ ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyi byon zan dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi mchod yon dang po bsang chu bzung nas thab du cung zad blug la/

oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra agne ye pra wa ra kharka ra pra titstsha swāhā/ zhes dang mchod yon gnyis pa nas gong bzhin cung zad phul la/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra agne ye i maṃ arghaṃ ma ya datte gṛhna siddhi pra matstsha swāhā/ zhes brjod zhabs bsil phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra agne ye i maṃ pā dyaṃ ma ya/ sogs gong bzhin de bzhin du gong 'og 'dra ba la/ badzra puṣpe/ badzra dhu pe/ badzra ā lo ke badzra gandhe/ badzra nai wi dya/ badzra shapta ma ya dattaṃ gṛhna siddhi me pra yatstsha swāhā/ ces rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod nang mchod mtheb srin gyi gtor la/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra sa pa ka anne/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas phul pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyis sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub ba'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /kalpa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs spyod pa/ /bdud rtsi bcud ldan ghunḍe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing / /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol yang / /thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs 'dzin/ /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad rab stsol ba/ /bdag gzhan 'byor pa'i sa la bzhugs/ /tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yam shing nas dza ti la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs kyi bar rim bzhin lag pa g.yon nas bzung la g.yas pas mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te/

mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul lo/ /yam shing la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ye swāhā/ mar la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ sha lnga bdud rtsi'i lnga la/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra agne swāhā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ ku sha la/ oṃ badzra a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ dur ba la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā bāe gā ya swāhā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma ra ya swāhā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya swāhā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya swāhā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ya swāhā/ dza ti la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs la/ oṃ mā ha shrī ba la batti ni swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams sngags dang bcas pa lan bdun re'i mjug tu/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig brjod cing dbul/ de nas me lha gong bzhin sngags thog mtha' sbyar pa'i puṣpe nas/ shapta'i bar gyis rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod pa rnams byas la mar blug gzar gang thab nang du blugs la mchod yon gsum mi phul/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ me lha thugs ka'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ ces brjod pa rnams kyi 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod la/ ༈ /gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar mi dgos pa'i phyir bud shing rtsig pa dang mchod pa bsreg rdzas rnams kha cung zad gsos la/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin rlabs byas/ de nas thab la bsang chu gtor zhing / sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa bsrung 'khor bskyed pa ni/ nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang ste/

g.yas bskum pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin bskyed nas/ dur khrod brgyad kyi tshom bu'i mgo sngags mi dgos/ steng gi cha la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / dur khrod brgyad du chos skyong ba dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang phyogs skyong ba chen po bcu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams gsal bar bzhugs par gyur/ de nas/ lha rnams kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du yab rnams kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ sogs nas/ yab rnams kyi gnas su yum dang / yum rnams kyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs bzhin go cha gnyis bkod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad phaiṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /sogs shlau ka gsum/ oṃ badzra he ru ka e hye he bha ga wan e he kā ya waktsitta sa ma ye nā tsā pantsa a mri te arghaṃ pra titstsha paṃ pu dzaṃ pra sa ra ya/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sgrub thabs kyi tshogs zhing ltar phyi nang yid 'byung gis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsanḍa saṃ bha ri maṇḍal la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni dzña na agni ye di bya di bya bi shuddhe swāhā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags sngags lhag chad kyis nyes pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi gong bzhin mar gyi byon kun dbul/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor na/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/

ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor chos thams cad rnam par dag la/ bdag kyang de'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /sngags bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing lag par pad skor 'khyud rgya lan gsum bya'o/ /slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi skor ba phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin phyi nang yid byung gi mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ shrī tsakra bī ra satwaṃ/ kā kā sye/ ū lū ka sye/ shwa nā sye/ pū ka ra ye/ ya ma dā dhī ye/ ya ma du tī ye/ ya ma diṣṭiṇye/ ya ma ma thā nī ye/ badzri bhā wā a bhi ṣintsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing / zhes pa nas/ don yod grub pa'i dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas sngags mchod/ phyi mchod/ nang bsangs ba/ yid 'byung bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin la phyi mchod dang / bstod pa la rol mo bya'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dus gcig tu phul bar bsam bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍal la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni oṃ badzra dzwa la ya sarba pa pāṃ shintaṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pa bsam shing dang / de bzhin thog mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la bar du mar sogs/ rdzas so so'i sngags bcu drug la 'bum/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til lam yungs dkar gang rung la bcu cha'i grangs bdag nyid rjes sa chen 'phags pa sogs kyi lha sngags la rgyas bsdus gsum gsum gsungs kyang / rje sa chen gyi bsdus pa'i lha sngags yab kyi nye snying yi ge bdun ma la bya bar gsungs pa'i bcu cha'i phyag len la yang yi ge bdun pa la mdzad/

skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rigs pa 'bul/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya dang bcu re 'bul pa dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yod pas gong 'og skabs su gang babs su bcu tshan bcu gcig 'bul ba'i bcu tshan re re'i tha ma la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs spel tshig can lan re brjod/ thog mthar gnyis gong bzhin la bar gyi bcu tshan dgu po yi ge bdun pa 'ba' zhig gi 'bul lo/ /de yang bsreg rdzas rnams dang mar dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ zas mchog gsum zhal du ku sha dur ba'i myu gu dbu'i gtsug tor la/ 'bras bu la sogs pa gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu phul par bsam mo/ /mthar gang ba'i sbyin sreg byon zan bzhin mar gyi lan bdun sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa dbul/ de nas gong bzhin sngags mchod phyi nang gsang ba yid 'byung bstod pa rkang brgyad gnyis rnams rol mo dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya'o/ /gtor ma rnams yi dam chos skyong sogs rang gang byed gtor chog bzhin phul/ de rdzas chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sbyangs byin rlabs bsdus pa sgrub thabs kyi phyi mchod bzhin byas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ nas/ ghanḍe ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa phyi mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod/ oṃ hrī ha ha sogs 'khyud rgya dang / a nu rā ga sogs kyi mnyes mchod/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi sogs sngags dang bcas pas yid mchod/ rol mo dang bcas pas rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor ba dang / sogs kyi nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod/ /sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ he ru ka muḥye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/

zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar rnams su thig le bya'o/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// ༈ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mar blug gzar gang thab du blug la/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ me lha zhal gcig phyag bzhi phyi nang gi lha dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i sngags dang bcas pa bdun re mjug tu spel tshig dang bcas dbul/ slar yang / oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra sa pā ka agne ye swāhā/ zhes pa spel tshig dang bcas pa'i mar gyi gang ba'i sbyin sreg bdun phul la/ de nas puṣpe la sogs pa gong bzhin gyi phyi mchod rol mo dang bcas pa nang mchod bstod pa rnams gong bzhin byas/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra sa pā ka agne ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ bā lya di swāhā/ gsum dang / int+ra ye/ agne/ ya ma ye/ ni ri te ye/ ba ru ṇa ye/ ba ya be ye/ i shwa ra ye/ adhaṃ mba ha ma/ a ti pra ti bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba sogs gsum gyi phul la gong bzhin phyi nang bstod pa rnams kyi mchod/ de nas/ oṃ agne ye dza hi dza hi sya arthān tsai wa pa ra arthān tsi sadhī twa gatstsha ha bya bhū ka zhes brjod nas sbyangs la phyag rgya phyir dkrol te/ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ slar yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi lhag chad kha skang /

gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du sogs go cha gsum dgod pa mtshams rngams sngags kyi bsrungs ba dga' ba gsum dran pa/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /sogs nas/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni sogs tshigs bcad gnyis sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pa'i mthar/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs yi dam chos skyong gi bkra shis rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas bya'o/ /thun gnyis pa len la gong gi phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ zhes pa'i rjes su gtong skabs rjes su phur gdab bsangs chu gnyis sgrub pa rnams nyi ma lnga la tshugs pa'i nyin min pa mi dgos pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas byin rlabs nas mtshams re bya'o/ /phur gdab rnams dang mda' dra sogs sbyin sreg ma grol pa bzhag grol ba'i rdo rje bzhag pa'i gung mo gnyis sbyangs pa'i phur bu rnams 'don pa'i tshul byas la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ces pa theng bcu brjod pa dang bstun dngos su slob mas phur bu rnams phur gdab bzhin phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor/ steng 'og dang bcas pa bsdus/ de nas mda' dra tshon skud dang bcas pa bsdu ste thal ba rnams rin po che'ii snod du blugs te rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i rgya mtshor bab pa'i chu bor dor/ mchod rdzas dman pa rnams kyang de bzhin du byas pa'i chu la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du gyur ro/ /ces slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyis sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ 'grel tshad don ldan gong ma rnams kyi yig cha rnams dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chen po'i nag po pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho tsam gnang 'dug pa la gzhi byas shing / de nyid kyi zhabs tog la dmigs te cung zad mi gsal rnams gsal bar bkod pa ni dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug tu gus pas len pa/

sa skya pa grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rigs dang chos kyi bu la bsam zhing rang nyid kyang chos tshul 'di nyid la sngon gyi las smon gyi shin tu dad gus che ba dang bcas te rgya gar lugs la rakṣa sa/ zhes pa srin po dang / rgya nag lugs la shing mo yos la hor zla bcu gcig pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi gzhi thog bla brang du sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang / dpal he ru ka'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bzod par mdzad du gsol/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs/ /nag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg ngag 'don rnams/ /gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba yi/ /bdag gzhan ma gyur sems can rnams/ /sgrib gnyis sbyang shing sa lam dag /rim gyi bgrod nas he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ru shrī tsakra saṃ bā ra ya/ srid pa'i 'khor lo zad mi shes/ /zag med ye shes su sdom pa/ /bla ma he ru ka gsum bdag /btud de las gsum sbyin sreg bshad/ /de la 'dir ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho/ /snyigs dus slar yang mi yi zol/ /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros zhes/ /'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bka'/ /gnang pa ltar lung gi sgrub nus dang dngos po'i chos nyid mngon sum pa de nyid kyi zhal sgo nas byon pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon nag po zhabs la he ru ka nyid kyi mngon sum du bka' gnang thob pa'i gzhung drug gras sbyin sreg las zhi ba'i bskor nag 'gros gtan 'bebs gnang ba nyid las zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos rnams bla chen 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung las/ nyung ngur btus nas bris bar bya ste/

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting 'dzin brtan pa dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa sngon du song bas sngags kyi nus pa byung ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga brtsam par bya ste/ de la slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum du bsdus te/ bla na med pa dang / nang dang phyi'o/ /bla na med pa de yang / rnam pa gsum ste/ sdom 'byung gi dgongs pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi thab khung du/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong dag gi dgang gzar dang blugs gzar dag gis khams gsum pa'i sems can dang sems byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa'i bsreg rdzas kun nas bsreg par byed pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sreg blugs dang / phyag chen thig le'i dgongs pa ni/ rjes su chags pa chen po'i ye shes kyi me kun nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyangs pa'i thab khung du rdo rje'i thugs gzar gyis byang chub sems kyi bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa bde ba chen po'i bsreg blugs dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dgongs pa ni/ dri ma med cing rab tu gsal/ ye shes kyi rnam par 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i sprul pa la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams kyi thab khung du ra pī ni dang / la la nā'i blugs gzar dang / dgang gzar dges khams yongs su dag pa'i bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa dag byin gyis rlabs pa'i bsreg blugs dang / ye shes thig le'i dgongs pa ni/ gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i lus kyi thab kyi kha'i hoṃ khung du lag pa gnyis kyi dgang gzar blugs gzar dag gi bza' ba dang btung ba'i bsreg rdzas blugs par byed pa 'di ni nang gi bdag nyid kyi sbyin bsreg yin no/

/'dir las dang po pa'i bya ba'i rim pa yin pa'i phyir/ phyi'i sbyin bsreg ci ltar bya ba'i tshul brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang dben zhing yid du 'ong ba la phun sum tshogs pa'i sa phyogs su ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i sa'i cho ga bya ste/ dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe sbyin bsreg bya ba'i thab la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ de la phyogs ni yon gyi bdag po la sogs pa'i don du de nyid kyi gnas kyi phyogs dang / rang gi don la ni rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs rnams su bya'o/ /kha lta ba'i phyogs ni dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba thab khung gi shar du gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor dang thab la phyogs pa'i phyir nub tu blta'o/ /gzhan rnams la'ang 'di'i tshul gyi bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba rnams ni zhi ba la shar dang / rgyas pa la byang du lta ba la sogs pa nyid do/ /dbyibs ni tshul gzhan las dbang du bya ba la zla gam dang / drag po la gru gsum du gsungs kyang / 'dir dbang du bya ba la gru gsum dang / drag po la zla gam du gsungs pa ni/ me dang rlung dag pa 'od dpag med dang / don grub pa'i las de dag 'grub pa la dgongs te/ rgyud sde gzhan las kyang 'di ltar 'byung ngo / /zhi ba'i bud shing 'o ma can gyi rtse'i cha las byung ba/ me bram ze'i rgyun bzhag rgyas pa'i bud shing 'bras bu can gyi rkad pa'i cha/ me rgyal po'i thab/ dbang gi bud shing me tog dmar po 'bar ba'i shing / me smad tshong ma'i khyim/ drag po'i bud shing tsher ba can gyi rtsa ba'i cha/ me shan pa'i khyim nas byung ba'o/ /las dang 'brel ba'i bud shing de dag ma rnyed na cung zad bsre ba'am/ gang rnyed pa'i bud shing der mos te sbom phra dang / ring thung thab dang 'tshams par bya'o/ /me de dag ma rnyed na zhi ba la shing 'o ma can rtsub las byung ba'am/ dgon pa'i me'am/ rgyas la lcags sam/ me shel las byung ba'i me'am/ dge 'dun gyi gnas las byung ba'i me'am/

dbang du bya ba la/ me tog dmar po can gyi shing rtsubs las byung ba'am/ lam du bus pa las byung ba'i me dang / drag po la rdo rtsub pa las byung ba'am/ ro bsregs pa'i me las bya'o/ /yang na ji ltar rnyed pa las byas kyang nyes pa med do/ /yam shing ni bud shing gi rgyu las byung ba de'i tshad las cung zad thung zhing phra ba la mar dang sbrang rtsi dang dri bzang pos byug go /drag po la ni khrag dang dug dang zhag gi byug par bya'o/ /thab chung ba la rgyar khru gang dang / de bzhin du khru gnyis pa nas shin tu che ba la khru bcu drug pa'i bar du bya zhing / zabs su de'i phyed dang ldan par bya'o/ /thab khung gang pa la sor bzhi'i kha phyed phyir bskyed la/ padma'i phreng ba dang / de'i phyir rol du 'phang dang zheng du sor bzhi'i sa'i mu ran brtsigs pa la gri gug gi phreng ba dgod par bya'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol du zheng sor bzhi pa la 'phang du sor gnyis pa'i las kyi kha khyer brtsigs pa/ zhi ba la/ rdo rje kha zum pa dang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis de'i phyi gru bzhi zla phyed rdo rje dang bcas pa las gzhan ma gsungs/ 'phags pa rin po che dang / rgyas pa rin po che dang / dbang du bya ba la padma dmar po dang / drag po la rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa'i phreng ba bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du khru gnyis pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar gyi thab khung la ni sor brgyad pa nas sor drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i bar gyi kha khyer la sogs pa bskyed de snga ma'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /thab kyi dbus su de dang 'tshams pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gtso bo'i mtshan ma rdo rje dang / yum gyi phyag mtshan rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pas las kyi kha khyer gyi phyi rol du/ thab dang 'tshams pa'i tshad gzhal te/ rwa ba ka ba rtsibs dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum la rdo rje dang gri gug sngon po/

padma dang gri gug dmar po/ 'khor lo dang gri gug dkar po rnams bri zhing / de'i phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gzhan dang mtshungs par cha chen dang cha phran gyi thig gis cha byed nas/ rtsig pa lnga/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ 'dod snam/ pha gu/ drwa ba/ drwa phyed/ mda' g.yab/ pu shu/ rta bab/ padma'i phreng ba/ dur khrod/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog can gyi mu khyud/ rdo rje'i phreng ba/ me'i phreng ba/ grwa bzhi/ rdo rje phyed pa rnams bri'o/ /nang gi sgo bzhi g.yon skor du phyogs kyi mdog can gyi shar du lcags kyu/ byang du dril bu/ nub tu lcags sgrog lhor zhags pa rnams rim pa bzhin dang / mtshams bzhi sngo zhing ser ba ser zhing dmar ba/ dmar zhing ljang ba ljang zhi sngo ba'i mdog can gyi gri gug bzhi shar lho nas bzung g.yas bskor du bri'o/ /phyi rol gyi mu khyud la shar phyogs su tshangs pa 'khor bcas kyi padma/ dbyug gu gsum/ phreng ba/ ril ba spyi blugs/ khri snyen sa la'i pags pa rnams bri'o/ /lhor dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyi mdung rtse gsum pa/ zla ba tshes pa/ rgyal mtshan/ ral pa'i cod paṇa/ mig rnams bri'o/ /nub tu khyab 'jug 'khor bcas kyi 'khor lo/ dung / dbyug tho/ ral gri/ phub rnams bri'o/ /byang du gzhon du karti ka 'khor bcas kyi mdung thung / dril bu/ ba dan/ rma bya/ ra skyes rnams bris bar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir byed pa'i thab khung ni/ rgyas pa'i thab khung / zhi ba'i thab las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba dang / dbang du bya ba'i thab zhi ba dang mnyam dang / drag po la zhi ba'i thab khung bas drug cha'i tshad kyi dma' bar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i rgyas pa la sogs pa'i thab kyang / khru gang pa ni khru bcu drug pa'i bar ji ltar mos pa byas par rung ba nyid do/ /dbang gi thab khung du 'gug pa dang / drag po'i thab khung du bskrad pa dang / dbye ba dang / rengs pa la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/

/saṃ bu ṭa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ thab khung zhes bya ba ni zlum po dang / gru bzhi dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / gru gsum mo/ /zhes 'byung ba las/ bla ma'i man ngag gis/ ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyis rgyas pa'i thab khung gi nang du zhi ba'i thab dang de'i nang du dbang gi thab khung gru gsum pa bya zhing / de'i ngos dag tu zla gam gsum byung ba ni drag po'i thab khung yin la/ nang gi thab de dag so so'i mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i las kyi kha khyer dang ldan par bya zhing / zabs su brko bar mi bya'o/ /de'i dbus su bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyi rol tu sngar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bri'o/ /de las thams cad kyi sbyin sreg byar rung ba nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dgongs pa ni/ zhi ba'i thab khung nyid du nyi shu las gang byed pa'i mtshan ma bkod nas las de'i sbyin bsreg byar rung ba nyid do/ /thab khung de dag gi zabs su bskor bar mi rung ba'am/ mi nus pa la ni bris pas rung ngo / /de ltar sgrub pa'i thab khung gong du smos pa'i bud shing thab dang mtshams shing / dbyibs mtshungs la 'phang cung zad mtho bar rtsig go /zhi ba la gos dang stan dkar po dang / shel dang / dngul dang / mu tig la sogs pa rin po che dkar po/ me tog dkar po la sogs pas brgyan pa'am/ yang na bcos pa'i rgyan bya ba nyid do/ /rgyas pa la/ stan dang / gos dang / dar dpyangs la sogs pa thams cad ser pos kun nas klubs cing / rgyan ser po'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bya'o/ /dbang du bya ba la stan dang gos dmar po dang / rin po che dang me tog dmar po la sogs pa yid du 'ong bas spras par bya'o/ /drag po la stan dang gos nag po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang / mi'i g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang rus pa dang sbrul la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bya'o/

/zhi ba la pus 'khyud gtsug te bram ze rig byed 'don pa lta bu tsog bu'i skyil mo nyid dang / rgyas pa la skyil mo krung las rkang pa g.yas pa cung zad brkyang ba rgyal po rol ba'i tshul lam/ stan tho ba la gnas nas rkang pa gnyis cung zad brkyang ba bzang po'i 'dug stang dang / dbang du bya ba la rkang pa'i mthil sprad pa padma'i skyil krung ngam/ rdo rje skyil krung dang / drag po la g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan pa'am/ yang na g.yon brkyang ba'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas te bya'o/ /zhi ba la rab tu zhi zhing dul la phan pa dang mnyes bzhin pa'i bsam pa dang / rgyas pa la dga' zhing spro la gzengs stod pa dang / dbang du bya ba brtse zhing gtsug la rjes su chags pa dang / drag po la khro zhing 'khrul pa rngam pa'i yid kyis bya'o/ /zhi ba la srod kyi dus dang / rgyas pa la snga dro dang / dbang du bya ba la phyi dro dang / drag po la nyi ma phyed dang nam phyed kyi dus su bya zhing / gzar bu 'dzin pa'i tshul yang zhi ba la byang chub mchog rgya/ rgyas pa la rin chen khu tshur/ dbang dang dgug pa la pad ma'i khu tshur/ drag po'i rigs la khro bo'i khu tshur/ mda' dra nas bsreg rdzas bsham pa'i bar sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi yi ge 'di sor bzhag la/ zhi ba la til/ rgyas pa la zas mchog dbang la me tog dmar po/ drag po la sha sna rnams rdzas kyi gtso bo yin/ dgang gzar blugs gzar ni lcags la sogs pa'i rin po che'am/ nemba la sogs pa'i shing gi rgyu las byung ba'i dgang gzar che ba'i tshad kyi yu ba'i chur khru do dang / sbom phra de dang 'tshams pa/ gzar bu'i dbus su zlum po brgyad dang zabs su sor bzhi pa la ri mo gru gsum pa dang ldan pa'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i snying po la rdo rje 'phang du sor bzhi pa bkod do/ /zlum po'i phyi rol du sor gnyis pa'i tshad la de dang mtshams pa'i kha khyer dang / mu ran rim pa gnyis kyi nang la rdo rje dang /

phyi rol du padma'i 'dab ma'i phreng ba dang / bar du nor bu'i phreng ba dang bcas pas bskor bar bya ste/ de ltar na zheng dang chur sor brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /de'i mdun na srid du sor bzhi dang ldan pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ khu bcud 'dzag pa'i don du ra dbus mthe'u chung gi tshad kyi sbub dang ldan pa'o/ /yu ba'i rtsa bar sor drug pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / sor gnyis pa'i zhur rin chen mdzes par bya'o/ /blugs gzar ni yu ba khru gang gi tshad dang ldan zhing / chu dang zabs su sor gsum pa'i zlum po'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje mtshan pa kha khyer dang mu ran sor gcig pa rtse mo byin gyis brlabs/ phra ba padma'i 'dab ma'i ba'i yi ge dbyibs lta bu yu ba'i rtsa bar sor bzhi pa'i rdo rje dang / sor gcig pa'i nor bus mtshan zhing / gnyis ka'i dngos gzhi chu srin gyi kha nas byung bar bya'o/ /tshad chung ba la ni gnyis ka'i yu ba khru gang ba'i tshad du bya zhing dgang gzar gyi gru bzhi pa'i zheng dang chur sor bzhi pa'i dbus su brgyad dang zabs su sor gsum pa'i zlum po sor gsum pa'i rdo rje'i mtshan pa dang / de'i mdun gyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa'ang sor gsum gyi tshad dang ldan par bya'o/ /blugs gzar ni rgyar sor do la dpangs su sor gang pas kha khyer dang / mu ran cung zad ldan pa/ padma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs lta bu sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dgang gzar gyi yu ba'i rtsa ba sor bzhi pa'i tshad kyi rdo rje/ sor gnyis pa'i tshad kyi nor bu dang / blugs kyi rtsa bar sor gsum pa'i rdo rje dang / sor gcig pa'i nor bu'i mtshan par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i dgang blugs ma 'byor na ni lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga bsdus pa dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum bsdus pas bya'o/ /me lha'i mchod yon zhi bar dung chos sam/ dngul snod du/ 'o ma/ 'bras/ yos/ ku sha btab pa/ rgyas pa la ser snod sogs su zho dang /

me tog ser po/ dbang la zangs snod sogs su/ me tog dmar po/ drag po la thod pa dang rdzas snod du khrag zhag me tog nag po/ thams cad kyi sbyar gzhi ni dri bzang gi chu ste sbyor ba'i chas/ dngos gzhi ni/ zhi ba gong gi sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi yig cha sor bzhag la der oṃ āḥswāhā zhes pas yam shing byin rlabs kyi sngags dang me lha sa pā ka zhes dngos ming de chad 'dug pas 'jug rgyu dang / ༈ /dngos gzhi la mchod pa byin rlabs nas thab bsang sbyangs bar 'dra/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung rgyar khru do/ zabs su khru gang / kha khyer la zhes pa nas gri gug bar dang / las kyi kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ gzhan 'dra/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha bskyed chog la/ laṃ las dang chen po'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa'i steng du raṃ gyi bgrang 'phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ma henḍa sku mdog ser po gzi brjid kyi phung po rab tu 'bar zhing / rin po che'i brgyan gyi spras pa/ ra skyes la zhon pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rtse gsum dang rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbyin lus thams cad las rin po che dang / 'dod rgu'i rgyun 'babs pas rgyas pa'i las sgrub pa/ gzhan 'dra/ spyan 'dren gyi sngags la/ hi twa bha wa'i rjes su/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ma henḍa agna ye ma ma puṣṭiṃ ku ru bau ṣa ṭa oṃ/ rgyas 'debs don grub gyi rang bzhin lā mas dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i sngags spel la/ ma ma puṣṭiṃ ku ru bau ṣa ṭa oṃ me lha'i zhal dang dgang blugs khar traṃ bkod la oṃ a ā ma ye bau ṣa ṭa/ bsreg rdzas kyi spel tshig ni 'gre/ gzhan zhi ba bzhin/ dbang la mi 'dra ba dbang gi thab khung dmar po gru gsum rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed las kyi kha khyer la padma dmar po'i phreng ba me lha'i gdan raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa me lha kā ma sku mdog dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/

phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang lcags kyu dang / g.yon gnyis na bgrang phreng dang zhags pa/ lus las 'gro ba thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ gzhan 'dra/ spyan 'dren sngags/ hi twa bha wa'i rjes su/ oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra kā ma agna ye tri dhā tu wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ rgyas 'debs la 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin khaṇḍa ro hi'i dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i sngags spel la/ ma ma tri dhā tu wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhal dang dgang blugs la hrīḥ oṃ khaṇḍa ro ha wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ gzhan zhi ba bzhin/ drag po la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ drag po'i thab khung zla gam nag por rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed las kyi kha khyer la rdo rje rtse gsum gdengs pas mtshan pa/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon shin tu g.yo zhing 'khrug pa'i steng du me lha kro dha sku mdog nag po shin tu 'phros pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ral gri g.yon gnyis na bgrang phreng dang zhags pa/ spyan 'dren sngags/ hi twa bha wa'i rjes su oṃ he ru ka ma hā badzra kro dha agna ye dzaḥ hi to pra ya sarba sha trun bighna na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rgyas 'debs rin 'byung gi rang bzhin gtsug can yas dbur brgyan/ ku sha'i sngags spel la sarba sha trun bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhal dang dgang blugs la āḥ oṃ tū yi nī ye mā ra ya phaṭa/ gzhan zhi ba bzhin min 'dug bas 'das pa'i me lhar yang spel tshig sogs rnam dbye sbyor dgos/ rnams rigs 'gre sreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i bstod pa la/ thabs dang shes rab mchog gi rnal 'byor dang / /sbas pa'i yul lnga'i dpal las bskrun gyur pa'i/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa'i rang bzhin/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi'i mnyam nyid gnas kyi mchog bzhugs shing / /stong nyid snying rjes gnyis su med pa'i bdag /yang dag ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo nyid/

/bde mchog bde ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bas khro dang chags pas chags pa dang / /rmongs pas kun rmongs nyid dang spros pa yis/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma rab tu zhi mdzad ma/ /khro chags 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med khyab bdag dung drung bde chen thugs/ /kun nas sku dang kun nas dbyangs ldan zhing / /kun tu rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul can/ /kun mdzad kun sdud he ru ka dpal 'dud/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed dang rol pa'i yum/ /dngos grub ma lus pa ni kun gyi gzhi/ /gnas rnams kun la dbang sgyur dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems dang ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ngo bo nyid/ /dpa' bo chen po'i zhal bzhi'i spyod yul ba/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gnas dang nye gnas las byung der gnas shing / /rab dga' dri med gsar gnas tshul 'dzin dang / /'dun pa brtson 'grus spyod pa'i sems dang ni/ /dad brtson ting 'dzin dran dang rnam dag la/ /rgyal ba kun gyis thugs kyi gsang ba'i bdag /mkha' la kun spyod nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /ba bla sbyong mdzad thugs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang nye zhing tshando nye tshando/ /dpal sa byung shing der gnas 'od byed dang / /'od 'phro sbyangs dka' mngon gyur sa gnas tshul/ /shes rab dad brtson dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /shes rab ting 'dzin brtson 'grus rnam dag la/ /gsang gi ngo bo sa spyod byu ru'i mdog /sa steng sbyong mdzad gsung gi 'khor lo yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'du ba nye 'du dur khrod nye ba yi/ /dur khrod las 'byung der gnas ring yong dang / /mi g.yo legs pa'i blo gros chos sprin tshul/ /dga' ba sbyangs pa chos 'byor dran btang snyoms/ /lta ba rtogs dang ngag dag sku yi dngos/ /sa 'og spyod tshul zla ba'i mdog mtshungs pa/

/sa 'og sbyong mdzad sku yi 'khor lo yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'thung spyod nye 'thung las byung der gnas shing / /tshig gnyis ma mthong / dpe med ye shes tshul 'dzin cing / /las dang tsho ba stsol dang dran pa dang / /dge ba bskyed dang srung dang mi dge ba/ /spong dang mi bskyod ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /rgyal ba'i dam tshig phrin las ngo bo nyid/ /sna tshogs kun tu spyod pa sna tshogs mdog /dam tshig 'khor lo'i dpa' mo rnams la 'dud/ /lus dang 'byung ba rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /zag med ye shes chen po'i spyod yul nyid/ /snod kyi 'jig rten kun nas yongs sbyong ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo brgyad gnas gyur 'jig rten chos skyongs ba'i/ /dur khrod chen po 'di na legs gnas nas/ /dkyil 'khor mchod dang 'byung po yongs sdud dang / /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ba/ /phyogs bdag zhing skyong grub pa rig 'dzin dang / /mkha' 'gro ma dang klu dbang la sogs pa/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas sogs/ /dur khrod gnas pa rnams la༞ /mi rtog ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ /mi byed srid zhi'i phyogs las rnam rgyal ba/ /mi g.yo brtan pa'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi/ /me dpung 'bar ba srung ba'i 'khor lo 'dud/ /dngos gzhi'i 'phro dang rjes ni 'dra ba nyid do/ /'on kyang thal ba skyel tshul mi 'dra ba las bzhi'i sbyin sreg spyi 'dre bzhin no/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'khor lo na'am/ /rnam bzhi'i sbyin sreg kun dga'i lam/ /blo gros zab mos dbang gyur las/ /srid mtha'i snying por de skad lo// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi ngag 'don dang phyag len/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
